L13·N10939unmasked layer
Fires on the head/second element of specialized multi-word compound noun phrases and proper names (the token that completes a noun+noun term), e.g. the "uts(al)" of "futsal field", "communities" in "retirement communities", "High" in "Ripon High School", "nutrition" before "labelling", "hi" of "washi tape", "Medicine" in "nuclear Medicine department"; it is suppressed on generic function/filler words in ordinary prose ("will", "things", "a", "programme").
